header.save_all_desc: Back up every project as one ZIP
header.load_all_desc: Restore all projects from a workspace ZIP

upload.hint: PNG, JPG, WebP · auto-compressed to <900 KB

tips.pos: Shifts the device on the canvas. 0 = centered. Use the center button to snap to center, or reset to the default layout position.
tips.size: Scales the device up or down uniformly. 100% fills the default slot size.
tips.tilt: Rotates the 3D frame in perspective. Drag left or right up to ±60°.
tips.apply_bg: Copies this slide's background to every other slide in the project.
tips.apply_text: Copies font, size, color, alignment and shadow to every other slide.

help.title: Help
help.start_1: Upload a screenshot in the Upload tab
help.start_2: Pick a device frame in the Frame tab
help.start_3: Set a background and edit headline text
help.start_4: Click Export Slides to download PNGs
help.tip_apply: Use Apply to all in the Background and Text panels to sync a style across every slide at once.
help.tip_save_all: Save All Projects backs up your entire workspace — handy before switching devices.
help.tip_tilt: 3D frames have a Tilt slider in the Frame tab. Drag it to add perspective depth.
help.tip_slides: Each project supports up to 8 slides, each with its own format, frame, and background.

callout.hint: Drag on the screenshot to create a zoom callout
callout.hint_max: Max 3 callouts — remove one to add another
